title: Stylized house
brief: Stylized house and room with more accessories, guided camera, day cycle kept. References: Bruno Simon, Jesse Zhou, Henry Heffernan.

artboards.title: Warm baked low-poly
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to Bruno Simon: rounded toy-like shapes and baked light. Cheapest to render and very readable; less intimate at night.

artboards.title: Cozy diorama
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to Jesse Zhou: warm lamps, dense accessories, hand-painted textures. Most personality; needs the most modeling and texture work.

artboards.title: Lofi night neon
artboards.tradeoff: Lofi-hip-hop mood: dusk palette with neon accents and soft bloom. Strong at night; day needs a separate palette to avoid looking flat.
